findings.issue: BR9 calls ce_type a CloudEvents 1.0 attribute. The item gives no meaning for it, so this is invented, and the row is Not applied.
Retention row BR Field ID is a DOR item ID, not a BR. The item requires every data row to carry a BR Field ID; BR1 and BR6 fit this row.
Says MSG-P1-001 already matches Error Standard v4 with no edit needed, but the diff changes that text to the v4 wording (R-26988). The two rulings conflict.
